responsibility: Declares reusable tree/GIMPLE data-flow helper APIs for SSA-based middle-end code. It exposes statement-UID renumbering, variable and DFA dump helpers, SSA default-definition accessors, base-and-extent/address decomposition routines, abnormal-SSA-name detection and repair, and declaration-enumeration dumping services that many GIMPLE transformation and analysis passes depend on.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public declarations for generic tree/GIMPLE data-flow utilities, exposing helper APIs and prototypes that are implemented in tree-dfa.cc rather than containing the analysis logic itself.
